nes_input_sets.primary: USER DECISION 2026-10-21: <sae>_smooth = centred 0.6 s mean of the frame max codes, no firing threshold (keeps the behaviour alignment; align.json v2_smooth)
nes_input_sets.secondary: <sae>: the same smoothed codes zeroed below the fnorm firing threshold (pre-specified, but it destroys alignment: mice nose_nose R~ 0.174 raw -> 0.093, ants v2 groom_any 0.629 -> 0.075)
nes_input_sets.prob: <sae>_prob: per-neuron P(on | smoothed code), label-free (src/eci/v2/prob.py): a 2-component Gaussian mixture on log of the positive smoothed codes of the calibration videos; P(on) = posterior of the higher component (a probability under the mixture model), monotone, 0 on silent frames. NES mean on it = expected fraction of time active per video; the runners' bout rate and latency threshold P(on) at its pooled q 0.95 (not an expected bout count). Single-neuron rank alignment (R~ / AUROC) is invariant to this monotone per-neuron map, so align.json v2_prob is a sanity check only.
nes_input_sets.raw: <sae>_raw: frame max codes, no smoothing (alignment reference)
nes_input_sets.binary_map: <sae>_map: 1[P(on) > 0.5], per-neuron MAP of the lognormal mixture (won the held-out family selection vs gamma); bouts / latency on it use threshold 0 (above = active)
